scope: CPU-only weight geometry for the physical select-20 base and its pinned second-visit norm sidecar. No tokens, labels, activations, fitting, model invocation or GPU admission.
primary: Sum squared coefficient differences for direct input projections. Identity: A diag(1+a) versus B diag(1+b). Donor: A diag(1+b) versus B diag(1+b). A and a are the actual retained matrix and norm; B and b are from its removed counterpart. Report one minus pooled donor SSE over identity SSE, not an average of layer percentages.
secondary: Report per-layer and pre-attention/pre-MLP effects, moved-map norm relative to the anchor, and independent column-Gram reconstruction. Do not score output projections, attention kernels, nonlinearities or downstream layers.
limits: The Frobenius metric weights normalized hidden coordinates equally. Real hidden inputs need not be isotropic. BF16 activation rounding and all downstream effects are absent. A better or worse weight match is not a decision score or an inference gate.
